account.title: Which account?
account.intro: amo reads your deals and their clients from one amoCRM or Kommo account, and changes them only with your permission.
account.host.hint: The address you open the CRM at: https://<subdomain>.amocrm.ru, or https://<subdomain>.kommo.com for Kommo.
integration.title: Create a private integration
integration.amocrm:
An account administrator does this once, in amoCRM:

1. Open **амоМаркет**, click **⋯** at the top left and choose **«Создать интеграцию»**.
2. Give it a name and a description, such as *WireCat*.
3. As the Redirect URI, enter `https://wirecat.dev/webhooks/apps/amo-callback`. The token does not use it, but the same integration then also works for a browser sign-in later.
4. Tick **«Доступ к данным аккаунта»** and save.

amoCRM's guide: https://www.amocrm.ru/developers/content/oauth/step-by-step
integration.waiver: On an account that is not marked technical, amoCRM first asks you to sign a waiver of technical support for a private integration. amoCRM says it cannot be taken back. Read it before you sign: https://www.amocrm.ru/developers/content/integrations/intro
integration.kommo.title: On Kommo
integration.kommo: Settings → Integrations → **Create integration**, a private one. Use the same Redirect URI, then open its **Keys and scopes** tab.
token.title: Make the token
token.where: In the integration, open the **«Ключи»** tab (Kommo: **Keys and scopes**) and click **«Сгенерировать токен»**. Pick an end date, from one day to five years, and copy the token: it is shown only once.
token.label: Long-lived token
token.hint: Kept in your system keyring or, without one, in a file only you can read.
token.rights: The token acts with the rights of the administrator who made it. amo stops agents' changes with its permissions: `amo <profile> config set permissions …`.
check.title: Checking the token
check.body: amo asks the account who the token belongs to. It saves the address and the token only if the account answers.
failed.title: The check did not pass
failed.body: The token or the account did not pass amo's check, so nothing was saved. Check the address, the token and your connection, then try again.
done.title: Connected
done.body: The profile is ready. Copy your deals and their clients into WireCat, then list the open ones:
done.oauth.title: Advanced: sign in through the integration instead
done.oauth: Instead of a token, an administrator can sign in through the integration in the browser, with its ID and secret key, and amo renews that sign-in itself. amoCRM lets only an account's administrators allow access this way. Run this in a terminal; the secret key is asked hidden:
role.title: Are you an administrator of this account?
role.intro: Only an amoCRM account administrator can create the integration and its token. If you are not one, an administrator makes the token for you.
role.admin.hint: You see амоМаркет in the menu on the left and can create integrations.
role.member.hint: There is no амоМаркет in your menu. An administrator sends you the token.
ask.title: Ask an administrator for the token
ask.body:
Send an administrator of your account this request:

> Please create a private WireCat integration in амоМаркет and send me its long-lived token. How: https://wirecat.dev/en/docs/amo/installation

The administrator creates the integration, clicks **«Сгенерировать токен»** on its **«Ключи»** tab and passes you the token. The token works like a password: pass it through a password manager, not a group chat.
ask.rights: An amoCRM long-lived token acts with the rights of the administrator who made it. With it you see and can change what that administrator can. amo still stops agents' changes with its permissions.
ask.later: When you have the token, go on to the next step and paste it.
token.member: Paste the token the administrator sent you. If it is lost, the administrator can make a new one on the **«Ключи»** tab of the same integration.
done.own: The token is the administrator's, so a sync copies the administrator's deals at first. Find your own id in the list of users and put it in place of 7001, and your account's address in place of example.amocrm.ru. Only you can change this setting; an agent cannot.
method.title: How do you want to sign in?
method.intro: Signing in with amoCRM takes one click in the browser and copies nothing by hand. It works for accounts at amocrm.ru; for Kommo, use a token.
method.browser.hint: amoCRM creates a WireCat integration in the account, and amo renews the sign-in itself.
method.token.hint: You create a private integration and paste its token here.
connect.title: Allow access in amoCRM
connect.body: Open the link below. On connect.wirecat.dev, click amoCRM's button, choose the account and click **«Разрешить»**. amoCRM creates the WireCat integration in it and sends the integration's secret key to connect.wirecat.dev, which passes it to amo once and keeps no copy. amo saves the sign-in only after the account answers.
connect.admin: amoCRM lets only an account administrator allow this. The integration then shows in амоМаркет, where an administrator can switch it off.
